Positive-semidefinite differences yield convex sublevel sets. The radial cap and hole entry/exit roots are explicit; strict opposite monotonicities of their normalized ratios prove the sharp all-weight visibility surface. The disk tangency and vertical-cross-section argument give the exact convexity surface and nonconvexity throughout the remainder. The uncountably many parameters are covered by an analytic proof. A standalone finite verifier passed 12338 diagnostics, including exact rational witness arithmetic.

value.rationale: The star-convexity hypothesis is central to recent analytical treatment of nonconvex quadratic Voronoi cells. This result determines the least number of sites needed for nonconvex site-visible cells and, within a natural continuous family with one stronger and one weaker quadratic scale on opposite sides, gives both exact sharp phase surfaces and complete equality/boundary classifications for all parameters. This is a structural separation of two geometric properties, not an isolated numeric sample or a routine formula substitution.
